operation_details.item: The user's North America business unit runs its ERP on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the upcoming board discussion, I suggest we frame the ERP landscape around operating-model implications rather than technical detail. That should keep the conversation focused on execution risk and decision rights.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The Europe business unit runs its ERP on Oracle.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. We can use Europe as one reference point while distinguishing platform differences from genuinely different business requirements.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The Asia business unit runs its ERP on NetSuite.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us a second contrast in the portfolio. I would recommend showing the board where standardization is valuable and where forcing one approach could create unnecessary disruption.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The North America business unit runs its ERP on SAP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: With three different platforms in view, the key message should be disciplined governance rather than an automatic technology-consolidation program.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The IT architecture review covers all three units.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That scope is appropriate. The review should compare integration, data ownership, controls, and delivery capacity across the full operating footprint.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the board materials to make the trade-offs clear without turning the discussion into a platform-by-platform status report.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: We can structure the materials around three decisions: what must be common, what may remain locally optimized, and what governance mechanisms will manage the interfaces.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That framing works. Please emphasize execution sequencing and accountability in the recommendation.
